name: lockfile-lens
description: Explain risky npm lockfile changes before they merge.

scripts.check: node --check bin/lockfile-lens.js && node --check bin/action.js && node --check src/analyzer.js && node --check src/reporters.js
scripts.demo: node bin/lockfile-lens.js examples/risky-app --before examples/risky-app/package-lock.before.json --format html --output lockfile-lens-report.html --fail-on none
